parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (0.988972) as it regressed from my best (0.987441). It seems the slight increase in LR might have caused some instability. I will return to my best config and attempt a more surgical reduction of the learning rate to 0.04 to improve convergence.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.04 to improve convergence stability and settle into a better local minimum.
